newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 8.56 pct at Italy lira repo.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 8.56 pct at Italy lira repo.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 7.0 trillion lire 7-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 8.56 percent, compared with 8.58 percent previously, the Bank said.
The average rate was 8.59 percent against 8.70 percent at the last repurchase pact for 14.0 trillion lire and 7 days on August 26.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for resale on September 9. The Bank said it received 44 bids of which eight were met in full and three in part.
